mnemonic.meaning: 通 pass + 信 message: passing messages along.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUU, SHIN!" (つうしん) Two (ツー) messages shin-kicked across the network.

examples.ja: 地震で通信が途絶えた。
examples.en: Communications were cut off by the earthquake.

items.note: Technical: 通信料 (data charges), 通信販売 (mail order).

mnemonic.meaning: 贈 has 貝 (money/shell): giving something of value.
mnemonic.reading: "OKURU!" (おくる) Same sound as 送る (send). You send a gift.

examples.ja: 母の日に花を贈った。
examples.en: I gave flowers for Mother's Day.

items.note: 贈る = give a gift or award. 送る = send or see off.

mnemonic.meaning: 鎖 has 金 (metal): metal links.
mnemonic.reading: "KUSARI!" (くさり) Kusa (grass) won't hold, so use a chain.

examples.ja: 犬が鎖につながれている。
examples.en: The dog is on a chain.

items.note: Also figurative: 鎖を断ち切る (break the chains).

mnemonic.meaning: 弾 has 弓 (bow): something shot from a bow.
mnemonic.reading: "TAMA!" (たま) Same sound as 玉 (ball). A bullet is a hard little ball.

examples.ja: 銃に弾を込めた。
examples.en: He loaded the gun with bullets.

items.note: Read だん in compounds: 爆弾 (bomb).

mnemonic.meaning: 現 present + 代 age: the present age.
mnemonic.reading: "GEN, DIE!" (げんだい) Generation today.

examples.ja: 現代の若者は本をあまり読まない。
examples.en: Young people today don't read many books.

items.note: 現代的 = modern. 近代 (きんだい) = the modern era (roughly 1868-1945).

mnemonic.meaning: 昼 noon + 食 food: noon food.
mnemonic.reading: "CHUU, SHOKU!" (ちゅうしょく) You chew your lunch.

examples.ja: 会議の前に昼食をとった。
examples.en: I had lunch before the meeting.

items.note: Formal; 昼ご飯 / お昼 are everyday. 朝食 = breakfast, 夕食 = dinner.

mnemonic.meaning: 加 add + 減 decrease: adding and taking away until it's right.
mnemonic.reading: "KA, GEN!" (かげん) Ka-gen: adjust it a bit.

examples.ja: 塩の加減がちょうどいい。
examples.en: The amount of salt is just right.

items.note: Many uses: 手加減 (going easy), いい加減 (sloppy or "enough!"), お加減 (health).

mnemonic.meaning: 物 thing + 音 sound: the sound of something.
mnemonic.reading: "MONO, OTO!" (ものおと) The sound (音) of some thing (物).

examples.ja: 夜中に物音がして目が覚めた。
examples.en: A noise woke me up in the middle of the night.

items.note: An unexplained sound, often unsettling. 音 is general sound.

mnemonic.meaning: 食 food + 料 material: food supplies.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOKU, RYOU!" (しょくりょう) Food for Ryo.

examples.ja: 一週間分の食料を買った。
examples.en: I bought a week's worth of food.

items.note: 食料 = food in general. 食糧 (same reading) is staple food like grain.

mnemonic.meaning: 係 = 亻 (person) + 系 (connection): the person connected to a job.
mnemonic.reading: "KAKARI!" (かかり) Same root as かかる: the person it depends on.

examples.ja: 係の人に聞いてください。
examples.en: Please ask the person in charge.

items.note: Usually a role: 受付係 (receptionist). In compounds: がかり.

mnemonic.meaning: 夫 husband + 人 person: the husband's person. A polite word for wife.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO, JIN!" (ふじん) Foo the lady drinks gin.

examples.ja: 大統領夫人が会場に到着した。
examples.en: The president's wife arrived at the venue.

items.note: Polite, for someone else's wife. 婦人 (also ふじん) means women in general.

mnemonic.meaning: 付 attach + 合 together: attach yourselves together.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUKI, AU!" (つきあう) Meet (会う) under the moon (月, つき).

examples.ja: 二人は三年間付き合っている。
examples.en: The two of them have been going out for three years.

items.note: Usually written 付き合う. Also "keep someone company": 買い物に付き合う.

mnemonic.meaning: 像 = 亻 (person) + 象 (elephant/image): an image of a person. A statue.
mnemonic.reading: "ZOU!" (ぞう) Same sound as 象 (elephant): an elephant statue.

examples.ja: 駅前に犬の像がある。
examples.en: There's a statue of a dog in front of the station.

items.note: Also image or picture: 映像 (video), 想像 (imagination).

mnemonic.meaning: 愉 pleasure + 快 pleasant: a happy, pleasant feeling.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, KAI!" (ゆかい) You're cheerful, Kai.

examples.ja: 彼は愉快な人だ。
examples.en: He's a fun person.

items.note: 不愉快 = unpleasant, which is more common in speech.

mnemonic.meaning: 賢 has 貝 (money): wise people save their money.
mnemonic.reading: "KASHIKO-I!" (かしこい) Cash-ko: a clever kid saves cash.

examples.ja: この犬はとても賢い。
examples.en: This dog is very smart.

items.note: 頭がいい is everyday. 賢い is a little more about good judgement.

mnemonic.meaning: NIKKORI: the corners of your mouth go up, "nik!"

examples.ja: 赤ちゃんがにっこり笑った。
examples.en: The baby smiled sweetly.

items.note: A broad, friendly smile. にこにこ = smiling continuously.

mnemonic.meaning: 有 have + 効 effect: it has an effect.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, KOU!" (ゆうこう) You go: your ticket is valid.

examples.ja: このチケットは今月まで有効だ。
examples.en: This ticket is valid until this month.

items.note: 有効期限 = expiry date. 無効 = invalid.

mnemonic.meaning: 班 = two 王 (jewels) split by 刀 (knife): dividing into groups.
mnemonic.reading: "HAN!" (はん) Han Solo leads a team.

examples.ja: 五人ずつの班に分かれた。
examples.en: We split into groups of five.

items.note: Small teams at school or work.

mnemonic.meaning: 別 separate: being separated.
mnemonic.reading: "WAKARE!" (わかれ) From 別れる (to part).

examples.ja: 別れの時が来た。
examples.en: The time to say goodbye has come.

items.note: 別れ話 = a breakup talk. Same reading as 分かれ (branch).

mnemonic.meaning: 課 assign + 題 topic: an assigned topic.
mnemonic.reading: "KA, DIE!" (かだい) Car die: a problem to solve.

examples.ja: 夏休みの課題がまだ終わらない。
examples.en: I still haven't finished my summer homework.

items.note: Homework, or an issue to tackle: 今後の課題 (things to work on).

mnemonic.meaning: 経 (warp threads) + 緯 (weft threads): the threads of how things happened.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, EE!" (けいい) Okay, explain the details. Also read いきさつ.

examples.ja: 事件の経緯を説明してください。
examples.en: Please explain how the incident came about.

items.note: Also longitude and latitude. いきさつ is the softer reading.

mnemonic.meaning: 哀 has 口 (mouth) in 衣 (clothes): crying into your sleeve.
mnemonic.reading: "AWARE!" (あわれ) Aware of how pitiful it is.

examples.ja: 雨にぬれた子猫が哀れだった。
examples.en: The rain-soaked kitten was pitiful.

items.note: Literary. もののあはれ is a classic aesthetic idea.

mnemonic.meaning: 博 broad + 士 gentleman: a gentleman of broad learning.
mnemonic.reading: "HAKASE!" (はかせ) Special reading. Often in kids' cartoons: the professor.

examples.ja: 彼は物理学の博士だ。
examples.en: He has a doctorate in physics.

items.note: Formal reading: はくし. Not a medical doctor (医者).

mnemonic.meaning: 体 body + 温 warm: body warmth.
mnemonic.reading: "TAI, ON!" (たいおん) Turn on the thermometer.

examples.ja: 体温を測ったら、三十八度あった。
examples.en: I took my temperature and it was 38 degrees.

items.note: 体温計 = thermometer.

mnemonic.meaning: 偉 eminent + 大 big: eminent and big.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, DIE!" (いだい) Even great men die.

examples.ja: 彼は偉大な科学者だ。
examples.en: He is a great scientist.

items.note: Formal, for people and achievements. 偉い = important, admirable.

mnemonic.meaning: 狩 has 犭 (beast): chasing animals.
mnemonic.reading: "KARI!" (かり) Carry the game home after a hunt.

examples.ja: 昔の人は狩りをして暮らしていた。
examples.en: People long ago lived by hunting.

items.note: Also picking: いちご狩り (strawberry picking), 紅葉狩り (autumn leaf viewing).

mnemonic.meaning: WAGAMAMA: "WAGA (my) MAMA!" A child who wants it their way.

examples.ja: わがままを言わないで。
examples.en: Don't be so selfish.

items.note: Kanji: 我が儘.

mnemonic.meaning: 有 have + 利 advantage: have the advantage.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, REE!" (ゆうり) You really have the edge.

examples.ja: 経験があると就職に有利だ。
examples.en: Experience gives you an edge when job-hunting.

items.note: Opposite: 不利 (ふり, Level 12).

mnemonic.meaning: 決 decide: something decided. A rule.
mnemonic.reading: "KIMARI!" (きまり) From 決まる (to be decided).

examples.ja: 学校の決まりを守りましょう。
examples.en: Let's follow the school rules.

items.note: Everyday word for rules. お決まりの = the usual. 決まりが悪い = embarrassed.

mnemonic.meaning: 手 hand + 間 time: hand-time. The work it takes.
mnemonic.reading: "TE, MA!" (てま) Your hand (手) and your time (間).

examples.ja: この料理は手間がかかる。
examples.en: This dish takes a lot of work.

items.note: お手間をとらせました = sorry to take your time.
